---
title: "Ecosystem"
include-after-body:
  - text: |
      <script type="module">
        import { getCorePackages, getAtlases } from '../js/api.js';
        import { renderCorePackages, renderAtlases } from '../js/render.js';

        const coreContainer = document.getElementById('core-packages-grid');
        getCorePackages().then(pkgs => {
          coreContainer.classList.add('fade-in-up');
          renderCorePackages(pkgs, coreContainer);
        });

        const atlasContainer = document.getElementById('atlases-grid');
        let allAtlases = [];

        getAtlases().then(atlases => {
          allAtlases = atlases;
          atlasContainer.classList.add('fade-in-up');
          renderAtlases(atlases, atlasContainer);
          document.getElementById('atlas-count').textContent = atlases.length;
        });

        const searchInput = document.getElementById('atlas-search');
        searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
          const query = e.target.value.toLowerCase().trim();
          const filtered = allAtlases.filter(atlas =>
            atlas.title.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
            atlas.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
            (atlas.type && atlas.type.includes(query))
          );
          renderAtlases(filtered, atlasContainer);
          document.getElementById('atlas-count').textContent = filtered.length;
        });

      </script>
---

## Brain Atlases {.section-header}

The ggsegverse provides <span id="atlas-count">...</span> brain atlases for visualization, each available as 2D polygons and/or 3D meshes.

::: {.atlas-search-box}
<label for="atlas-search">Filter atlases</label>
<input type="text" id="atlas-search" placeholder="Search by name or type (cortical, subcortical, cerebellar, tract)..." />
:::
